thesis: Methodological naturalism, metaphysical naturalism, physicalism, atheism and agnosticism must not be conflated.

ideas.statement: Shared scientific method need not settle ontology; agnosticism permits firm evidence-based conclusions and unequal credence while keeping ultimate claims revisable.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Natural explanatory success can support philosophical naturalism but needs premises to exclude all divinity; neither quantum limits nor money-mindedness refutes physicalism.
